title: 26+32: taught parameterized lessons in one house notation across different kinds of text
scope: Creative source-level construction, no assigned Voynich meanings or native fit
human_purpose: A small community shares stable lessons and one concise notation for applying them. Practical instructions, observations and scheduled duties can therefore look related without being one continuous prose genre. Written messages carry the choices and arguments; memorized lessons supply explicitly priced fixed content.

complete_logical_contract.curriculum: A finite versioned library K, fixed before encoding any messages. Each lesson has a unique exact identifier, ordered typed parameters and a finite fully written expansion into elementary source propositions or actions. Expansion may call only earlier lessons, guaranteeing termination. No per-occurrence or per-page definition is allowed.
complete_logical_contract.source_domain: A finite ordered list of typed lesson applications under an explicit mode INSTRUCT, REPORT or SCHEDULE. Every application has all required arguments and optional qualifications only if declared in that lesson signature. Message equivalence retains mode, order, exact object identifiers, all quantities/units, polarity and conditions. It does not promise recovery of original prose wording. Messages outside K are outside the stated domain, never silently paraphrased.
complete_logical_contract.house_grammar: Every record is (mode, lesson identifier, ordered full arguments, explicit scope). The same framing, argument order and lesson expansion operate in every topical section. REPORT asserts completion of the expanded ordered actions; INSTRUCT requests them; SCHEDULE additionally supplies an exact named time condition. Mode cannot be guessed from an illustration.
complete_logical_contract.writer: Check every typed argument, mode and condition against K; serialize the complete record in fixed field order using length-framed UTF-8 literals for arbitrary identifiers and quantities. No omitted argument, inferred subject or implicit numeric default. This is a fully specified logical serialization, not a proposed 22-sign Voynich carrier.
complete_logical_contract.reader: Parse each record, resolve its exact library version and lesson identifier, substitute only its declared parameters without variable capture, recursively expand earlier lesson calls, and preserve outer mode and all stated qualifications. Missing K or an unknown identifier produces unresolved content rather than an invented expansion.
complete_logical_contract.physical_limit: No actual glyph code, native word boundary, lesson cue, mode marker or clause boundary is bound. A native writer remains incomplete; the logical contract must not be described as a whole-manuscript solution.

content_example.library: SOURCE-ONLY invented lesson P(x,a,b): move named item x to named place a; inspect x there; then move x to named place b. Parameter types are ITEM,PLACE,PLACE. No native string is assigned P or any of these meanings.
content_example.instruction: INSTRUCT P(sample,cup,box) expands into three ordered requested actions.
content_example.report: REPORT P(sample,cup,box) records the same three ordered actions as completed; it does not command them.
content_example.schedule: SCHEDULE P(tool,bench,shelf) AT named_event expands the same lesson under an explicit different item, places and temporal condition.
content_example.shared_content: What is shared is the actual three-step lesson and its parameter grammar, not merely the claim that all three messages are about doing something. The contrasting participant, place, mode and time information remains written.

price_of_missing_oral_content: Store every lesson expansion, parameter type, dependency and exceptional condition as real information in K. Cost is total curriculum description plus argument/framing code plus written message, not message length alone.
A library containing one arbitrary lesson for every target whole or paragraph is merely an opaque dictionary and earns no compositional explanation.

Oral acquisition cannot be distinguished from lookup in a lost written handbook when both provide the same K. The data-facing hypothesis is shared fixed expansions; the oral provenance is an additional historical hypothesis.
No speaker is allowed to fill in an unencoded patient, action, negation, quantity or exception merely because it sounds plausible.
unequal_consequences: Against an opaque whole-record dictionary with no composition: once one lesson and its parameter positions are independently bound, changing one supplied argument changes every declared occurrence of that argument in the expansion and nothing else. The same consequence must carry across modes and sections without a new card.

Against ordinary reference numbers: a bare address retrieves one fixed text, while a parameterized lesson retrieves a typed scheme and requires explicit bindings. However a parameterized reference manual is observationally the same mechanism; do not claim to distinguish it.

Against unrelated genre-specific codebooks: the same complete lesson cue, signature and parameter operations must retain their expansion across genres. Similar characters alone do not supply that evidence.

Against ordinary uncompressed prose: fixed taught multi-action content need not be written at every invocation. Without independent knowledge of that omitted content, these rivals need not be identifiable from text statistics alone.

grounded_next_action.action: Prepare one source-owned complete teaching-and-application pair that actually supplies both a reusable instruction and at least two differently bound full applications. Use the already retained source records first; make a one-page literal separation of fixed taught content versus explicitly supplied arguments, then identify whether any content remains guessed. Do not build a decoder or generate another roundtrip corpus.
grounded_next_action.current_source_review: Completed bounded primary review finds that Bartolomeo905 supplies a cue hierarchy with a retained exact-prefix countercase, Ragona906 supplies ordered names/card tuples rather than full proposition encoding, and907 supplies stable formulas with variable applications but no native shared writer. These provide genuine human precedents and sharply limit what can be borrowed. Their missing content must not be supplied by our invented lesson.
grounded_next_action.decision: If a complete paired source lesson is obtained, its fixed argument law provides a concrete comparator for a later whole native account; if only names, opaque formulas or partial introduction survive, retain this as a plausible information architecture rather than claiming demonstrated general prose compression. Existing incomplete examples are not an invitation to repeat their unchanged collation.
grounded_next_action.priority: Creative retained alternative. No native candidate selected and no claim that historical oral rather than written learning is identifiable.

historical_guess_quarantine: GDT417 and old workshop curricula are prior explorations with historical assigned meanings, not reusable lexical evidence. None of their Voynich values enters this contract. Bounded registry navigation and source cards do not establish global novelty.
work_record: User-authorized creative combination. Route/context, bounded ideas search/show, route-check and relevant lookup followups read. No native query/count/image, no source acquisition, no program, no meanings, no registry or route edit.
